newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russian and French leaders agree on new sanctions on Iraq during the summit in Denver.
- Egyptian president might join the meeting between Syrian president and Saudi crown prince planned in Syria on Tuesday.
- Egypt received 2,212 requests from Arabs to own real estate in the country in one year, mainly from Saudis.
- Kuwaiti investments in Tunisia increased in the last 20 years to $250 million.
- Kuwait and Jordan agree to resume flights in a month after a six-year halt.
- Lebanese officials consider visit by Saudi crown prince to Lebanon important.
- Jeddah-based Islamic Development Bank signs two contracts worth $30 million to finance educational projects in Lebanon.
